standard_prerequisites.name: Cone triangles represent distinguished triangles
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-the-same-up-to-isomorphisms (carded in this batch, L26170), cited at proof lines 3551, 3571, 3573, 3588
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that distinguished triangles of K(A) are exactly the triangles isomorphic to cone triangles, used to reduce TR1/TR2/TR3 to cone data.

standard_prerequisites.name: Rotation of cone triangles
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-rotate-triangle and lemma-rotate-cone, cited at proof lines 3563 and 3579; short source lemmas with complete proofs in the same chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the rotated-triangle identifications (with the sign bookkeeping) in the two directions of TR2.

standard_prerequisites.name: Functorial cone
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-functorial-cone, cited at proof line 3591; complete short proof at source lines 2736-2753
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the morphism of cone triangles in TR3.

standard_prerequisites.name: Reduction of TR4 for pre-triangulated categories
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-easier-axiom-four, cited at proof line 3597; complete proof at source lines 1064-1074
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that TR4 follows from the composable-pair octahedron statement.

standard_prerequisites.name: Lifting to split injections in K(A)
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-sequence-maps-split (carded L26103), cited at proof line 3599
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that the composable pair may be represented by split injective maps of complexes.

standard_prerequisites.name: Octahedron for split injections
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-two-split-injections, cited at proof line 3602; complete proof at source lines 3485-3534, queued for separate carding
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the octahedron in the split-injection case, finishing TR4.

core_obligations: TR1：恒等三角形由项分裂序列给出；任意态射 f 的锥三角形 (K,L,C(f),f,i,-p) 由 lemma-the-same-up-to-isomorphisms 给出（3546-3552 行）。
TR2：两个方向各执行——旋转回代、lemma-rotate-triangle 给出与锥三角形的同构、-1 预合成处理符号；反向从锥形式旋转（3555-3580 行）。
TR3：以 lemma-the-same-up-to-isomorphisms 化归到锥形式，对交换图应用 lemma-functorial-cone（3583-3592 行）。
TR4：lemma-easier-axiom-four 化归到可合成对八面体；lemma-sequence-maps-split 提升为分裂单射；由 lemma-two-split-injections 收尾（3595-3602 行）。
difficulty_reason: TR2 的旋转与符号簿记逐行执行；TR3/TR4 是三条完整源引理的实例化链，胶水数据（交换图、分裂单射代表元）写明。
